headline: HuyenBao v11.26 — Sức khoẻ bị hao mòn bởi mọi hành động: gigs (kể cả xem quảng cáo) giờ trừ sức khoẻ, chống spam lấy tiền
summary: HEALTH COSTS FOR ACTIONS. Every gig now drains health by its own 'hp' cost — watching an ad costs 0.5, delivery 2 (physical), freelance/tutor 1.5, sponsored 1, consult 2. The ad gig has no cooldown, so its small per-watch cost doubles as the anti-spam valve: an all-day ad grind wears the player down and can no longer be farmed for free money. Each gig shows its cost on the card (red 'health -n' next to the +$ pay) and queues a localised toast (EN/VI/ZH) when performed. Health is floored at 0 — a gig alone can never push it negative; if health hits 0 the game still ends with cause=health on the next day tick. Recovery paths are unchanged: gym (+6, $80), checkup (+15, $600), pet walks, good sleep and diet. Also re-verified the whole health system with new regression tests: the v11.20 hype/charity post drain still works, plain posts cost nothing, and grinding yourself to 0 still ends the run.
features: GIGS COST HEALTH: ad 0.5 · delivery 2 · freelance 1.5 · tutor 1.5 · sponsored 1 · consult 2 per action
ANTI-SPAM: the no-cooldown ad gig now self-limits — 20 ad watches/day = -10 health
UI: gig cards show '· health -n' (red) next to the +$ pay when ready
TOASTS: '💢 {gig} — the grind wears you down, health -n' localised × EN/VI/ZH
SAFETY: gig drain floors at 0; death-by-health still only judged on the day tick
TESTS: 7 new regression tests — per-gig drain, exact ad cost, floor, cumulative spam, localised toast, death integration, v11.20 hype-post drain
